final_message:
I changed the code so `OrderPlaced` should pass the two failing ARCH-4 checks. I haven't run the tests, typecheck or CI, because the shell command that would have run them was denied.

`OrderPlaced` now carries both the new fields (`createdAt`, `amountCents`) and the old ones (`placedAt`, `totalCents`). The old ones are marked `@deprecated` in `src/core/events.ts`, with the same values as the new ones. `analytics-ingest` and `billing-service` still require the old names, so they should pass again. The rename is not a clean break until they move off them. Once both have migrated, delete the two aliases.

I updated the expected event in `test/app.test.ts` to include all four fields. The `OrderCancelled` check was already passing and I didn't touch it.

Run `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` locally, or let CI re-run, to confirm. Both source files showed a note that they had changed on disk since I last read them. I re-read `src/core/events.ts` afterwards and it looks right. I did not re-read `test/app.test.ts`.

If you'd rather have a clean break, the alternative is a `schemaVersion` bump to 4, but that needs the two consumer teams to update their contracts first.
ticket_text: Update the OrderPlaced event by changing totalCents to amountCents and placedAt to createdAt; this brings its naming in line with the Payments and Customer APIs.
